rfc_extended_reference_vectors.description: Compatibility equivalent 'henryⅣ' (U+2163): disallowed by full RFC 8265 IdentifierClass (HasCompat), outside current bounded PrecisProfile.v model.

rfc_full_expected.reason: U+2163 has compatibility decomposition (<compat> 0049 0056) which is disallowed in IdentifierClass (RFC 7564 Section 9.17).

rfc_extended_reference_vectors.description: Math symbol '∞' (U+221E): disallowed by full RFC 8265 IdentifierClass (Symbols/Sm), outside current bounded PrecisProfile.v model.

rfc_full_expected.reason: U+221E (Sm) is disallowed in IdentifierClass (RFC 7564 Section 4.2.3).

rfc_extended_reference_vectors.description: Fullwidth Latin 'Ａｌｉｃｅ' (U+FF21..): mapped to 'alice' via Width Mapping in full UsernameCaseMapped, preserved in OpaqueString.

rfc_full_expected.reason: RFC 8265 Section 3.3 applies width mapping before case mapping.

rfc_extended_reference_vectors.description: Non-breaking space U+00A0 in 'pass\u00A0word': mapped to U+0020 in full OpaqueString, disallowed in full UsernameCaseMapped.

rfc_full_expected.reason: RFC 8265 Section 4.2.2 maps Unicode Zs spaces to ASCII U+0020.
